description: Land Acquisition - Kiriwaththuduwa, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific lots of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related matters.
